# Additional Resources

Below you will find PDFs of all of the material included in the language and grammar supplement in the _Concise English-Irish Dictionary_, which was published in 2020. While the book only includes the English-language version of this material, an Irish-language version of all items is available below. Click on the icon beside each item to open a PDF. All of the items are available to download and print in A4 form.

Click [here](https://focloir.ie/en/book) for more information about the _Concise English-Irish Dictionary_.
